what: Clicking a same-site link makes the accent-color light swell at the bottom of the screen over 1.7s (brightness cubic in-out, the backdrop darkly covered between 40% and 90%, grain .14) until it covers the screen, and the destination name (link text) rises 18px and fades in from 60%. Then over 1.5s the light fills in place out to the screen edge, the name leaves 14px upward at .38s and the page switches at .9s. The incoming page stays covered by the veil, finishes the remaining fill and lifts at 50ms (WebGL shader)

options.dur: Cover duration (seconds), default 1.7 — shorten it if you switch often like an app (0 goes straight with no curtain)
options.leave: Handoff point while filling up (sec), default 0.9
options.out: Length of the clearing after arriving (sec), default 0.05
options.data-veil-label: When set on a link, this name appears on the curtain instead of the link text
options.nav: With router, links are not intercepted — a single-page app router (barba etc.) covers the page with root.fxGlowVeil.cover(name) (released on leave at the destination), swaps the body, then calls reveal({ early, onEarly }) to clear it. Even after fully filled it waits for reveal, and onEarly is called early ms before the clearing

use: <body data-fx="glow-veil-page"> · what to do after arriving goes in the window fx:veil-done event, while the veil covers the page html has fx-veiled · for a single-page app use data-fx-glow-veil-page="nav: router" Attach it and call body.fxGlowVeil.cover/reveal from the router

from.where: shared.js (original PageTransition — sweep-in 1700ms: glow opacity io(t) · reveal t(.55+.45t) · .65 · alpha io((t−.4)/.5) · grain .14·io((t−.35)/.5) · label io((t−.6)/.4) translateY (1−u)·18px, then 1500ms reveal .65→1 · exit 0→1 · label −14px at 380ms, route change at 900ms, cleared in 50ms at +250ms after 1700+1250ms)

note: The original is a single-page app, so only the body changes while the curtain stays covered — nav: router takes that form (one site uses barba for <main> …is swapped out). The default type is for multi-page use: at the .9s fill-up point it writes the name and position to sessionStorage and navigates, and the arriving page continues from that spot. The light shader is our own, the same as glow-field. If WebGL is missing or reduced motion is on, it moves on immediately with no curtain.
